spec.title: Hummingbot Pair Trade (Mobin Gold) v5
spec.description: v5: multi-session select, shared cumulative baseline across sessions, gapless trading-time axis mapped to the dashboard time range (overnight/weekend removed). Gold ETF basket: mark-to-mid P&L, equal-weight mid indexes (All / Top5), excess vs benchmarks, weights, signals, rotation quality.

spec.__legacyStringValue: SELECT name AS __text, name AS __value FROM pair_trade.strategy ORDER BY name;

SELECT s.id::text || ' @ ' || to_char(s.started_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS __text, s.id AS __value FROM pair_trade.session s JOIN pair_trade.strategy st ON st.id = s.strategy_id WHERE st.name = '$strategy' ORDER BY s.started_at DESC;

spec.title: P&L (M IRT)
spec.description: Mark-to-mid P&L vs first portfolio_value across selected sessions (M IRT = IRR/1e7). Green if ≥ 0.

spec.rawSql: WITH start_nav AS (SELECT portfolio_value AS v FROM pair_trade.portfolio_snapshot WHERE session_id IN ($session) ORDER BY ts ASC LIMIT 1), latest AS (SELECT portfolio_value FROM pair_trade.portfolio_snapshot WHERE session_id IN ($session) ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT (latest.portfolio_value - start_nav.v) / 1e7 AS pnl_m_irt FROM latest, start_nav;

spec.title: P&L (%)
spec.description: 100 * (latest_NAV / first_NAV − 1) across selected sessions (shared baseline).

spec.rawSql: WITH start_nav AS (SELECT portfolio_value AS v FROM pair_trade.portfolio_snapshot WHERE session_id IN ($session) ORDER BY ts ASC LIMIT 1), latest AS (SELECT portfolio_value FROM pair_trade.portfolio_snapshot WHERE session_id IN ($session) ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT 100.0 * (latest.portfolio_value / NULLIF(start_nav.v, 0) - 1) AS pnl_pct FROM latest, start_nav;

spec.title: Portfolio value (M IRT)
spec.description: Latest mark-to-mid NAV from portfolio_snapshot across selected sessions (IRR / 1e7).

spec.rawSql: SELECT portfolio_value / 1e7 AS portfolio_m_irt FROM pair_trade.portfolio_snapshot WHERE session_id IN ($session) ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1;

spec.title: Incomplete rotations
spec.description: Count of rotation rows with status ≠ buy_complete across selected sessions.

spec.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS incomplete FROM pair_trade.rotation WHERE session_id IN ($session) AND status <> 'buy_complete';

spec.title: Rotation complete %
spec.description: Among sell→buy rotations (excludes cash_collector): 100 × buy_complete / count(*).

spec.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'buy_complete' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) END AS complete_rate FROM pair_trade.rotation WHERE session_id IN ($session) AND prev_symbol <> 'CASH';

spec.title: Net rotation cash (M IRT)
spec.description: Sum(quote_earned − quote_spent) for sell→buy across selected sessions.

spec.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(quote_earned - quote_spent), 0) / 1e7 AS net_cash_m_irt FROM pair_trade.rotation WHERE session_id IN ($session) AND prev_symbol <> 'CASH';

spec.title: Fills
spec.description: Total fill events across selected sessions.

spec.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS fills FROM pair_trade.fills WHERE session_id IN ($session);

spec.title: Portfolio P&L vs shared start (M IRT)
spec.description: Mark-to-mid P&L vs first NAV of selected sessions (M IRT). X-axis is trading-time (overnight/weekend/between-session gaps removed); samples are spread across the dashboard time range. Hover clock is compressed, not wall-clock. Filter via Session multi-select.

spec.rawSql:
WITH start_nav AS (SELECT portfolio_value AS v FROM pair_trade.portfolio_snapshot WHERE session_id IN ($session) ORDER BY ts ASC LIMIT 1), src AS (SELECT p.session_id, p.ts AS real_ts, (p.portfolio_value - sn.v) / 1e7 AS pnl_m FROM pair_trade.portfolio_snapshot p CROSS JOIN start_nav sn WHERE p.session_id IN ($session)), 
tmap AS (
  SELECT d.session_id,
         d.real_ts,
         to_timestamp($__unixEpochFrom())
           + (ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.started_at, d.real_ts) - 1)
           * (($__unixEpochTo() - $__unixEpochFrom())
              / GREATEST(COUNT(*) OVER (), 1))
           * INTERVAL '1 second' AS time
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT session_id, real_ts FROM src) d
  JOIN pair_trade.session s ON s.id = d.session_id
) SELECT m.time, s.pnl_m AS "P&L M IRT" FROM src s JOIN tmap m ON m.session_id = s.session_id AND m.real_ts = s.real_ts ORDER BY m.time;

spec.title: Portfolio return vs benchmark indexes (%)
spec.description: Portfolio % (shared first-NAV baseline) vs equal-weight mid indexes. All = every symbol; Top5 = عیار، طلا، کهربا، گنج، مثقال. Index: 100*(mid / first_mid − 1) from signal_snapshot (shared baseline). Portfolio aligned via forward-fill on bins. X-axis is trading-time (overnight/weekend/between-session gaps removed); samples are spread across the dashboard time range. Hover clock is compressed, not wall-clock. Filter via Session multi-select.

spec.rawSql:
WITH 
raw AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT ss.session_id, ss.bin_ts, ss.symbol, ss.mid_price
  FROM pair_trade.signal_snapshot ss
  WHERE session_id IN ($session)
),
sym_start AS (
  SELECT symbol,
         (array_agg(r.mid_price ORDER BY s.started_at, r.bin_ts))[1] AS m0
  FROM raw r
  JOIN pair_trade.session s ON s.id = r.session_id
  WHERE r.mid_price IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY symbol
),
idx AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT r.session_id,
         r.bin_ts AS real_ts,
         AVG(100.0 * (r.mid_price / NULLIF(ss.m0, 0) - 1)) AS all_pct,
         AVG(100.0 * (r.mid_price / NULLIF(ss.m0, 0) - 1))
           FILTER (WHERE r.symbol IN ('عیار', 'طلا', 'کهربا', 'گنج', 'مثقال')) AS top5_pct
  FROM raw r
  JOIN sym_start ss ON ss.symbol = r.symbol
  WHERE r.mid_price IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY r.session_id, r.bin_ts
), start_nav AS (SELECT portfolio_value AS v FROM pair_trade.portfolio_snapshot WHERE session_id IN ($session) ORDER BY ts ASC LIMIT 1), port AS (SELECT p.session_id, p.ts AS real_ts, 100.0 * (p.portfolio_value / NULLIF(sn.v, 0) - 1) AS port_pct FROM pair_trade.portfolio_snapshot p CROSS JOIN start_nav sn WHERE p.session_id IN ($session)), bins AS (SELECT DISTINCT session_id, bin_ts AS real_ts FROM raw), 
port_events AS (
  SELECT s.started_at, b.session_id, b.real_ts, 0 AS is_port, NULL::numeric AS port_pct
  FROM bins b
  JOIN pair_trade.session s ON s.id = b.session_id
  UNION ALL
  SELECT s.started_at, p.session_id, p.real_ts, 1 AS is_port, p.port_pct
  FROM port p
  JOIN pair_trade.session s ON s.id = p.session_id
),
port_seq AS (
  SELECT *,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY started_at, real_ts, is_port DESC) AS rn
  FROM port_events
),
with_fill_rn AS (
  SELECT *,
         MAX(CASE WHEN port_pct IS NOT NULL THEN rn END)
           OVER (ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS fill_rn
  FROM port_seq
),
bin_port AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT w.session_id, w.real_ts, p.port_pct
  FROM with_fill_rn w
  JOIN port_seq p ON p.rn = w.fill_rn
  WHERE w.is_port = 0
), result AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT bp.session_id, bp.real_ts, bp.port_pct, i.all_pct, i.top5_pct FROM bin_port bp JOIN idx i ON i.session_id = bp.session_id AND i.real_ts = bp.real_ts), src AS (SELECT session_id, real_ts FROM result), 
tmap AS (
  SELECT d.session_id,
         d.real_ts,
         to_timestamp($__unixEpochFrom())
           + (ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.started_at, d.real_ts) - 1)
           * (($__unixEpochTo() - $__unixEpochFrom())
              / GREATEST(COUNT(*) OVER (), 1))
           * INTERVAL '1 second' AS time
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT session_id, real_ts FROM src) d
  JOIN pair_trade.session s ON s.id = d.session_id
) SELECT m.time, r.port_pct AS "Portfolio %", r.all_pct AS "All index %", r.top5_pct AS "Top5 index %" FROM tmap m JOIN result r ON r.session_id = m.session_id AND r.real_ts = m.real_ts;

spec.title: Portfolio excess return vs indexes (%)
spec.description: Portfolio % minus each equal-weight mid index % (shared baselines). Positive = outperforming that benchmark. X-axis is trading-time (overnight/weekend/between-session gaps removed); samples are spread across the dashboard time range. Hover clock is compressed, not wall-clock. Filter via Session multi-select.

spec.rawSql:
WITH 
raw AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT ss.session_id, ss.bin_ts, ss.symbol, ss.mid_price
  FROM pair_trade.signal_snapshot ss
  WHERE session_id IN ($session)
),
sym_start AS (
  SELECT symbol,
         (array_agg(r.mid_price ORDER BY s.started_at, r.bin_ts))[1] AS m0
  FROM raw r
  JOIN pair_trade.session s ON s.id = r.session_id
  WHERE r.mid_price IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY symbol
),
idx AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT r.session_id,
         r.bin_ts AS real_ts,
         AVG(100.0 * (r.mid_price / NULLIF(ss.m0, 0) - 1)) AS all_pct,
         AVG(100.0 * (r.mid_price / NULLIF(ss.m0, 0) - 1))
           FILTER (WHERE r.symbol IN ('عیار', 'طلا', 'کهربا', 'گنج', 'مثقال')) AS top5_pct
  FROM raw r
  JOIN sym_start ss ON ss.symbol = r.symbol
  WHERE r.mid_price IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY r.session_id, r.bin_ts
), start_nav AS (SELECT portfolio_value AS v FROM pair_trade.portfolio_snapshot WHERE session_id IN ($session) ORDER BY ts ASC LIMIT 1), port AS (SELECT p.session_id, p.ts AS real_ts, 100.0 * (p.portfolio_value / NULLIF(sn.v, 0) - 1) AS port_pct FROM pair_trade.portfolio_snapshot p CROSS JOIN start_nav sn WHERE p.session_id IN ($session)), bins AS (SELECT DISTINCT session_id, bin_ts AS real_ts FROM raw), 
port_events AS (
  SELECT s.started_at, b.session_id, b.real_ts, 0 AS is_port, NULL::numeric AS port_pct
  FROM bins b
  JOIN pair_trade.session s ON s.id = b.session_id
  UNION ALL
  SELECT s.started_at, p.session_id, p.real_ts, 1 AS is_port, p.port_pct
  FROM port p
  JOIN pair_trade.session s ON s.id = p.session_id
),
port_seq AS (
  SELECT *,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY started_at, real_ts, is_port DESC) AS rn
  FROM port_events
),
with_fill_rn AS (
  SELECT *,
         MAX(CASE WHEN port_pct IS NOT NULL THEN rn END)
           OVER (ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS fill_rn
  FROM port_seq
),
bin_port AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT w.session_id, w.real_ts, p.port_pct
  FROM with_fill_rn w
  JOIN port_seq p ON p.rn = w.fill_rn
  WHERE w.is_port = 0
), result AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT bp.session_id, bp.real_ts, bp.port_pct, i.all_pct, i.top5_pct FROM bin_port bp JOIN idx i ON i.session_id = bp.session_id AND i.real_ts = bp.real_ts), src AS (SELECT session_id, real_ts FROM result), 
tmap AS (
  SELECT d.session_id,
         d.real_ts,
         to_timestamp($__unixEpochFrom())
           + (ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.started_at, d.real_ts) - 1)
           * (($__unixEpochTo() - $__unixEpochFrom())
              / GREATEST(COUNT(*) OVER (), 1))
           * INTERVAL '1 second' AS time
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT session_id, real_ts FROM src) d
  JOIN pair_trade.session s ON s.id = d.session_id
) SELECT m.time, r.port_pct - r.all_pct AS "Excess vs All %", r.port_pct - r.top5_pct AS "Excess vs Top5 %" FROM tmap m JOIN result r ON r.session_id = m.session_id AND r.real_ts = m.real_ts;

spec.title: Portfolio weights by asset (%)
spec.description: Share of mark-to-mid NAV per asset. Stacked area ≈ 100%. X-axis is trading-time (overnight/weekend/between-session gaps removed); samples are spread across the dashboard time range. Hover clock is compressed, not wall-clock. Filter via Session multi-select.

spec.rawSql:
WITH src AS (SELECT b.session_id, b.ts AS real_ts, 100.0 * CASE WHEN b.asset = 'IRR' THEN b.total ELSE b.total * COALESCE((SELECT kv.value::numeric FROM jsonb_each_text(p.marks) AS kv(key, value) WHERE kv.key LIKE b.asset || '-%' LIMIT 1), 0) END / NULLIF(p.portfolio_value, 0) AS value, b.asset AS metric FROM pair_trade.balance_snapshot b JOIN pair_trade.portfolio_snapshot p ON p.session_id = b.session_id AND p.ts = b.ts WHERE b.session_id IN ($session)), 
tmap AS (
  SELECT d.session_id,
         d.real_ts,
         to_timestamp($__unixEpochFrom())
           + (ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.started_at, d.real_ts) - 1)
           * (($__unixEpochTo() - $__unixEpochFrom())
              / GREATEST(COUNT(*) OVER (), 1))
           * INTERVAL '1 second' AS time
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT session_id, real_ts FROM src) d
  JOIN pair_trade.session s ON s.id = d.session_id
) SELECT m.time, s.value, s.metric FROM src s JOIN tmap m ON m.session_id = s.session_id AND m.real_ts = s.real_ts ORDER BY m.time;

spec.title: Latest portfolio composition (%)
spec.description: Pie of latest asset weights by mark-to-mid value across selected sessions. Cash = IRR.

spec.rawSql: WITH latest AS (SELECT MAX(ts) AS ts FROM pair_trade.portfolio_snapshot WHERE session_id IN ($session)), p AS (SELECT ts, portfolio_value, marks FROM pair_trade.portfolio_snapshot WHERE session_id IN ($session) AND ts = (SELECT ts FROM latest)), b AS (SELECT asset, SUM(total) AS total FROM pair_trade.balance_snapshot WHERE session_id IN ($session) AND ts = (SELECT ts FROM latest) GROUP BY asset), valued AS (SELECT p.ts AS time, b.asset AS metric, 100.0 * CASE WHEN b.asset = 'IRR' THEN b.total ELSE b.total * COALESCE((SELECT kv.value::numeric FROM jsonb_each_text(p.marks) AS kv(key, value) WHERE kv.key = b.asset || '-IRR' OR kv.key LIKE b.asset || '-%' LIMIT 1), 0) END / NULLIF(p.portfolio_value, 0) AS value FROM b CROSS JOIN p) SELECT time, value, metric FROM valued WHERE value > 0 ORDER BY value DESC;

spec.description: Free IRR cash (M IRT) and open strategy order count. X-axis is trading-time (overnight/weekend/between-session gaps removed); samples are spread across the dashboard time range. Hover clock is compressed, not wall-clock. Filter via Session multi-select.

spec.rawSql:
WITH src AS (SELECT session_id, ts AS real_ts, quote_balance / 1e7 AS v FROM pair_trade.basket_snapshot WHERE session_id IN ($session)), 
tmap AS (
  SELECT d.session_id,
         d.real_ts,
         to_timestamp($__unixEpochFrom())
           + (ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.started_at, d.real_ts) - 1)
           * (($__unixEpochTo() - $__unixEpochFrom())
              / GREATEST(COUNT(*) OVER (), 1))
           * INTERVAL '1 second' AS time
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT session_id, real_ts FROM src) d
  JOIN pair_trade.session s ON s.id = d.session_id
) SELECT m.time, s.v AS "Cash M IRT" FROM src s JOIN tmap m ON m.session_id = s.session_id AND m.real_ts = s.real_ts ORDER BY m.time;

WITH src AS (SELECT session_id, ts AS real_ts, pending_order_count AS v FROM pair_trade.basket_snapshot WHERE session_id IN ($session)), 
tmap AS (

         to_timestamp($__unixEpochFrom())
           + (ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.started_at, d.real_ts) - 1)
           * (($__unixEpochTo() - $__unixEpochFrom())
              / GREATEST(COUNT(*) OVER (), 1))
           * INTERVAL '1 second' AS time
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT session_id, real_ts FROM src) d

spec.rawSql:
WITH src AS (SELECT session_id, ts AS real_ts, jsonb_array_length(symbols) AS v FROM pair_trade.basket_snapshot WHERE session_id IN ($session)), 
tmap AS (

         d.real_ts,

spec.title: Lowest-ret symbol (cash target)
spec.description: Cash-collector target across selected sessions (wall-clock ts).

spec.rawSql: SELECT ts, session_id, lowest_ret_symbol FROM pair_trade.basket_snapshot WHERE session_id IN ($session) AND lowest_ret_symbol IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 100;

spec.title: Return signal by symbol
spec.description: EWM log-mid residual (signal_snapshot.ret). X-axis is trading-time (overnight/weekend/between-session gaps removed); samples are spread across the dashboard time range. Hover clock is compressed, not wall-clock. Filter via Session multi-select.

spec.rawSql:
WITH src AS (SELECT session_id, bin_ts AS real_ts, ret AS value, symbol AS metric FROM pair_trade.signal_snapshot WHERE session_id IN ($session) AND ret IS NOT NULL), 
tmap AS (
  SELECT d.session_id,
         d.real_ts,
         to_timestamp($__unixEpochFrom())
           + (ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.started_at, d.real_ts) - 1)
           * (($__unixEpochTo() - $__unixEpochFrom())
              / GREATEST(COUNT(*) OVER (), 1))
           * INTERVAL '1 second' AS time
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT session_id, real_ts FROM src) d
  JOIN pair_trade.session s ON s.id = d.session_id
) SELECT m.time, s.value AS value, s.metric AS metric FROM src s JOIN tmap m ON m.session_id = s.session_id AND m.real_ts = s.real_ts ORDER BY m.time;

spec.title: Return signal demeaned (cross-section)
spec.description: ret − mean(ret) per bin_ts across symbols. X-axis is trading-time (overnight/weekend/between-session gaps removed); samples are spread across the dashboard time range. Hover clock is compressed, not wall-clock. Filter via Session multi-select.

spec.rawSql:
WITH src AS (SELECT session_id, bin_ts AS real_ts, ret - AVG(ret) OVER (PARTITION BY session_id, bin_ts) AS value, symbol AS metric FROM pair_trade.signal_snapshot WHERE session_id IN ($session) AND ret IS NOT NULL), 
tmap AS (
  SELECT d.session_id,
         d.real_ts,
         to_timestamp($__unixEpochFrom())
           + (ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.started_at, d.real_ts) - 1)
           * (($__unixEpochTo() - $__unixEpochFrom())
              / GREATEST(COUNT(*) OVER (), 1))
           * INTERVAL '1 second' AS time
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT session_id, real_ts FROM src) d
  JOIN pair_trade.session s ON s.id = d.session_id
) SELECT m.time, s.value AS value, s.metric AS metric FROM src s JOIN tmap m ON m.session_id = s.session_id AND m.real_ts = s.real_ts ORDER BY m.time;

spec.title: Bid-ask spread % by symbol
spec.description: BA cost as percent (×100). X-axis is trading-time (overnight/weekend/between-session gaps removed); samples are spread across the dashboard time range. Hover clock is compressed, not wall-clock. Filter via Session multi-select.

spec.rawSql:
WITH src AS (SELECT session_id, bin_ts AS real_ts, ba_spread * 100 AS value, symbol AS metric FROM pair_trade.signal_snapshot WHERE session_id IN ($session) AND ba_spread IS NOT NULL), 
tmap AS (
  SELECT d.session_id,
         d.real_ts,
         to_timestamp($__unixEpochFrom())
           + (ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.started_at, d.real_ts) - 1)
           * (($__unixEpochTo() - $__unixEpochFrom())
              / GREATEST(COUNT(*) OVER (), 1))
           * INTERVAL '1 second' AS time
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT session_id, real_ts FROM src) d
  JOIN pair_trade.session s ON s.id = d.session_id
) SELECT m.time, s.value AS value, s.metric AS metric FROM src s JOIN tmap m ON m.session_id = s.session_id AND m.real_ts = s.real_ts ORDER BY m.time;

spec.title: Latest signals (all symbols)
spec.description: Latest freq bin across selected sessions. Ordered by ret+ba_spread ASC.

spec.rawSql: SELECT s.symbol, s.ret, s.ba_spread, s.mid_price / 1e7 AS mid_m_irt, s.ret_ask, s.ret_bid, s.ask_price / 1e7 AS ask_m_irt, s.bid_price / 1e7 AS bid_m_irt, (s.ret + s.ba_spread) AS ret_plus_spread, s.bin_ts, s.session_id FROM pair_trade.signal_snapshot s WHERE s.session_id IN ($session) AND s.bin_ts = (SELECT MAX(bin_ts) FROM pair_trade.signal_snapshot WHERE session_id IN ($session)) ORDER BY s.ret + s.ba_spread ASC NULLS LAST;

spec.title: Rotation edges (bps)
spec.description: Sell→buy only. expected/last/realized/realized_net ×10000 ≈ bps. X-axis is trading-time (overnight/weekend/between-session gaps removed); samples are spread across the dashboard time range. Hover clock is compressed, not wall-clock. Filter via Session multi-select.

spec.rawSql:
WITH src AS (SELECT session_id, ts AS real_ts, transition_score * 10000 AS value, 'expected' AS metric FROM pair_trade.rotation WHERE session_id IN ($session) AND prev_symbol <> 'CASH' AND transition_score IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT session_id, ts, last_edge * 10000, 'last' FROM pair_trade.rotation WHERE session_id IN ($session) AND prev_symbol <> 'CASH' AND last_edge IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT session_id, ts, realized_edge * 10000, 'realized' FROM pair_trade.rotation WHERE session_id IN ($session) AND prev_symbol <> 'CASH' AND realized_edge IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT session_id, ts, realized_edge_net * 10000, 'realized_net' FROM pair_trade.rotation WHERE session_id IN ($session) AND prev_symbol <> 'CASH' AND realized_edge_net IS NOT NULL), 
tmap AS (
  SELECT d.session_id,
         d.real_ts,
         to_timestamp($__unixEpochFrom())
           + (ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.started_at, d.real_ts) - 1)
           * (($__unixEpochTo() - $__unixEpochFrom())
              / GREATEST(COUNT(*) OVER (), 1))
           * INTERVAL '1 second' AS time
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT session_id, real_ts FROM src) d
  JOIN pair_trade.session s ON s.id = d.session_id
) SELECT m.time, s.value, s.metric FROM src s JOIN tmap m ON m.session_id = s.session_id AND m.real_ts = s.real_ts ORDER BY m.time;

WITH base AS (SELECT session_id, ts AS real_ts, realized_edge, realized_edge_net FROM pair_trade.rotation WHERE session_id IN ($session) AND prev_symbol <> 'CASH' AND (realized_edge IS NOT NULL OR realized_edge_net IS NOT NULL)), src AS (SELECT session_id, real_ts FROM base),

spec.title: Recent rotations
spec.description: Includes cash_collector. Wall-clock ts across selected sessions.

spec.rawSql: SELECT ts, session_id, CASE WHEN prev_symbol = 'CASH' THEN 'cash_collector' ELSE 'rotation' END AS kind, prev_symbol, new_symbol, status, transition_score, last_edge, realized_edge, realized_edge_net, sell_slippage, buy_slippage, latency_sec, transition_value / 1e7 AS transition_value_m_irt, quote_earned / 1e7 AS earned_m_irt, quote_spent / 1e7 AS spent_m_irt, total_fee_quote / 1e7 AS fees_m_irt, sell_order_id FROM pair_trade.rotation WHERE session_id IN ($session) ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 50;

spec.title: Fill volume by side
spec.description: Aggregated fills by side/pair across selected sessions.

spec.rawSql: SELECT side, trading_pair, COUNT(*) AS fills, ROUND(SUM(amount)::numeric, 6) AS base_volume, ROUND((SUM(amount * price) / 1e7)::numeric, 2) AS notional_m_irt, ROUND((SUM(fee_quote) / 1e7)::numeric, 4) AS fees_m_irt, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE rotation_id IS NULL) AS unlinked_fills FROM pair_trade.fills WHERE session_id IN ($session) GROUP BY side, trading_pair ORDER BY notional_m_irt DESC;

spec.title: Latest balances
spec.description: Latest total/available per asset across selected sessions.

spec.rawSql: SELECT DISTINCT ON (exchange, asset) exchange, asset, CASE WHEN asset = 'IRR' THEN total / 1e7 ELSE total END AS total, CASE WHEN asset = 'IRR' THEN available / 1e7 ELSE available END AS available, CASE WHEN asset = 'IRR' THEN 'M IRT' ELSE 'units' END AS unit, ts, session_id FROM pair_trade.balance_snapshot WHERE session_id IN ($session) ORDER BY exchange, asset, ts DESC;
